headline: 6 wickets needed: Bangladesh on brink of historic win in Darwin
summary: The Tigers are dominating the first Test against Australia, needing only 6 wickets to secure a landmark victory on Australian soil.
details: Bangladesh is in a commanding position in the first Test match against Australia in Darwin, maintaining their dominance through the third day of play.
The Tigers need only six more wickets to secure a historic victory, putting immense pressure on the Australian side.
Mehidy Hasan Miraz expressed confidence in the team's ability to make a comeback and win, stating that everyone in the squad believed in their potential.
A win in this match would be a landmark achievement for Bangladesh cricket, marking a significant milestone in their Test match performance on Australian soil.

headline_marked: Model-actress [[Ridhika Ridhi found dead]] in Bashundhara home
headline: Model-actress Ridhika Ridhi found dead in Bashundhara home
summary: The 26-year-old actress, whose real name was Lina Akhter, was found hanging from a ceiling fan in her rented apartment.
details: Police recovered the body of model and actress Ridhika Ridhi from a house in Dhaka’s Bashundhara residential area this morning.
Bhatara Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mazharul Islam confirmed that police recovered the woman's body hanging from a ceiling fan around 6:00 am.
The victim’s family is reportedly preparing to file an abetment of suicide case in connection with the incident.
A relative, Khondaker Abdur Rahman, stated that her real name was Lina Akhter and she was 26 years old.
Ridhi was her stage name, and she had rented the apartment in Bashundhara on her own.
caption:
A 26-year-old model and actress has been found dead in her Bashundhara home.

Police recovered the body of model and actress Ridhika Ridhi from a house in Dhaka’s Bashundhara residential area this morning.

Bhatara Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Mazharul Islam confirmed that police recovered the woman's body hanging from a ceiling fan around 6:00 am.

The victim’s family is reportedly preparing to file an abetment of suicide case in connection with the incident.

A relative, Khondaker Abdur Rahman, stated that her real name was Lina Akhter and she was 26 years old.

Ridhi was her stage name, and she had rented the apartment in Bashundhara on her own.

#Bangladesh #Dhaka #RidhikaRidhi #EntertainmentNews #BreakingNews

Source: Somoy News, The Daily Star, Dhaka Tribune
